title: Aurora/Northern Lights
content: Create aurora-inspired design with flowing, animated gradients. Use dark backgrounds (bg-slate-950 or bg-black) as canvas. Apply multi-color gradients with aurora colors: cyan-400, emerald-400, violet-500, pink-500. Create flowing shapes using large blur (blur-3xl) on gradient elements. Animate gradients slowly moving and morphing. Use glassmorphism cards (bg-white/10 backdrop-blur) over aurora background. Keep text light (text-white, text-gray-200) with subtle glow. Add subtle stars or particles for atmosphere. Create sense of depth with layered gradient elements.

variants.simple: Create ethereal design with flowing gradient backgrounds mimicking aurora borealis.
variants.detailed: Create aurora-inspired design with flowing, animated gradients. Use dark backgrounds (bg-slate-950 or bg-black) as canvas. Apply multi-color gradients with aurora colors: cyan-400, emerald-400, violet-500, pink-500. Create flowing shapes using large blur (blur-3xl) on gradient elements. Animate gradients slowly moving and morphing. Use glassmorphism cards (bg-white/10 backdrop-blur) over aurora background. Keep text light (text-white, text-gray-200) with subtle glow. Add subtle stars or particles for atmosphere. Create sense of depth with layered gradient elements.
variants.advanced: Create aurora borealis-inspired ethereal design. Base: dark canvas (bg-slate-950 or bg-black) representing night sky. Aurora implementation: multiple absolutely positioned div elements with gradient backgrounds (from-cyan-400 via-emerald-400 to-violet-500, from-pink-500 via-purple-500 to-indigo-500). Apply heavy blur (blur-[100px] or filter: blur(100px)) and mix-blend-mode: screen/overlay. Animation: use CSS keyframes for slow, organic movement - translateY, scale, and opacity changes over 15-30 second cycles. Each aurora layer moves at different speeds for parallax depth. Stagger animation delays. Stars: pseudo-random positioned dots using radial-gradient or SVG, some with twinkle animation. Content cards: glassmorphism style (bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10) floating over aurora. Typography: light colors (text-white, text-gray-300), add subtle text-shadow with aurora colors for glow effect on headings. Performance: use will-change on animated elements, consider reduced-motion preference to pause animations. Reduce aurora complexity on mobile for battery. Implementation options: CSS-only with keyframes, or canvas/WebGL for more dynamic effects. Layer order: stars (bottom), aurora layers (middle, 2-4 layers), content (top with z-index).
